author: KingEdeston1
body:
My minecraft name is KingEdeston1.

The reason I was banned was for "Do Not Teamspleef" on July 13, 2015 at 3:43:10 PM GMT by MOD: ParaSpider

The reason I should be unbanned from the server is not for me, but for my younger brother. I was unaware of him being banned from this server and tomorrow (August 13) at 3:43:10 PM GMT, will be exactly 1 month since he was banned. From my what my brother had told me, he was being attacked by his own teammates on a team based gamemode. Before he was killed, he tried to get back at his teammates , but failed. He was then banned from the server. I believe 1 month of being banned is enough for a 6 year old to reflect on his actions. It the ban were to be lifted I would greatly appreciate it. 

If you wish to contact me, my profile contains my Skype and Steam users.

Thank you for those who had the time to read over this.

title: I would like to appeal for my actions

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Hello,

Usually, we have an ordinance to where if your brother is breaking rules under your account, it puts you at fault as well (your account, your responsibility). Considering your brother griefed players, and the previous infractions behind it were the same offense (you had 8 teamkill punishments), I'm not convinced that this would earn an appeal.

Please keep in mind that retaliating against players when they grief you should be left to reporting them with /report, and not griefing them back (as you both would receive the same punishment). Permanent bans should be waited out for 6 months until you can make another appeal.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

Even though a month may indeed be a long enough time to realise your wrongdoings, you've been caught teamkilling/spleefing many times and that has therefore told us you clearly haven't learnt your lesson about the rules of teamkilling.
Come back to me in 5-6 months and I'll most likely appeal your ban.
-Denied

Regards,
Auratix_
